channel.title: Utility Dive - Latest News
channel.description: Utility industry news and analysis for energy professionals.

item.title: Permitting reform bill heads to House as Democratic divisions persist
item.description: Some Democrats say the party should not agree to a bill that contains what they consider troubling changes to environmental law and state and tribal authority. Others say no better deal is possible with a Republican president.
item.dc:creator: Diana DiGangi

item.title: Budderfly to invest $500M to finance and operate municipal energy upgrades
item.description: The energy-as-a-service company will recoup its investment from savings over a contract’s life. Such agreements have become more common, especially for large institutions like universities and hospitals, one expert said.
item.dc:creator: Charles Paullin

item.title: Market reforms bolster grid, may lower costs this winter: FERC
item.description: Improved coordination in the West will help offset lower hydropower output due to historically low water levels in the Colorado River basin, while New England risks overreliance on oil, FERC’s winter market and reliability report says.
item.dc:creator: Ethan Howland

item.title: Texas finalizes ERCOT CEO contract extension, pay raise tied to performance
item.description: CEO Pablo Vegas could take home more than $4 million next year. The contract extension and pay raise were put on hold in September following public outcry.
item.dc:creator: Robert Walton

item.title: Google signs 50-MW superhot geothermal PPA with Quaise Energy
item.description: The agreement will support Google's Oregon data center operations beginning as early as 2030, advancing development of a technology designed to access geothermal resources deeper underground.
item.dc:creator: Marlene Wilden
